text: The absence of clearly defined technology features for blockchain, distributed ledger, and associated terms propagates outward, producing knock-on definitional problems in other parts of the blockchain ecosystem.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Securities Versus Utility Tokens (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4021599
abstract: The lack of clearly defined technology features pertaining to blockchain technology, distributed ledger, and other associated terms has knock-on effects on other parts of the blockchain ecosystem.
